fragmented_workflow: Tasks in a spreadsheet or task app, disconnected from the artifacts they produce; no link to outputs
github_based_framework: Issues (or the reconstructed register) + Project board + closing keywords bind task -> commit -> PR
advantage: Tasks link to the exact changes that resolved them
caveat: Requires the Issue layer to be adopted; not exercised in the self-referential case

fragmented_workflow: Decisions live in email threads and meeting notes, often unrecorded; rationale is lost
github_based_framework: DECISION_LOG.md Dn entry + decision issue, each with rationale, alternatives and an Affects line
advantage: Reasoning is reconstructable; demonstrated across D1-D15
caveat: Convention-dependent; tacit decisions still go unrecorded

fragmented_workflow: Files named _v2_final_FINAL; no diff, no history, silent overwrites
github_based_framework: Git: line-level history, diff, blame, restore, tags
advantage: Every change is attributable and reversible
caveat: Learning curve; large binary / tabular data not versioned meaningfully

fragmented_workflow: Scattered documents across cloud and local storage; drift; no history
github_based_framework: Version-controlled Markdown in the repository, from project start, with per-folder READMEs
advantage: Documentation lives with the artifacts and carries its own history
caveat: Plain text only; requires Markdown literacy

fragmented_workflow: No systematic link between question, data, analysis and result
github_based_framework: Cross-references + closing keywords + timelines assemble the chain; release notes inherit it
advantage: The end-to-end chain can be reconstructed
caveat: Manual; no lineage query; stops at data / computation without deliberate discipline

fragmented_workflow: Status is known only to those in the email loop; no external view
github_based_framework: Public repository + Project status + Insights + activity log + CHANGELOG
advantage: Third parties can inspect progress and full history
caveat: Only once the repository is public; embargoed material must be withheld
